detail.longDescription: Amazon has begun blocking Meta's Muse AI agent on its retail site. Shoppers using Muse receive pop-up messages that the tool violates Amazon's terms of use. Source: The Economic Times https:// economictimes.indiatimes.com/t ech/artificial-intelligence/amazon-blocks-metas-muse-ai-agent-from-its-retail-site/articleshow/134396800.cms # AIAgents # Amazon # Meta
